extracted.name: Spicy grilled fish
extracted.description: Great recipe for Spicy grilled fish.
ingredient_lines: Pamfret or any other whole fish
Kashmiri red chilli 8 (soak both in 3tbs of vinegar)
All the above 3 dry ingredients also soak with chilli
Spread french fries when you bake 2nd 25 min
Serve with mustard sauce and wine
instruction_lines: Clean the fish nicely and slit 3 to 4 cuts
Grind the soaked ingredients as paste Apply the paste all over the fish, specially in the slit parts and inside stomach
Grease baking tray, keep the fish cover with foil and cook for 15 min then uncover and cook for another 15min
